title: Final Energy Dissipation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the time-averaged rate of energy dissipation.

title: Final Motion Solution
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the motion of the anharmonic oscillator, including first-order terms in alpha.

title: Correct Use of Complex Notation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply complex notation to find the steady-state solution for the damped oscillator.

title: Initial Conditions Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the initial conditions to determine constants in the solution for the anharmonic oscillator.

title: Energy Dissipation Consistency
description: Important Criteria: The student should show that the average power calculated matches the rate of energy dissipation.

title: Neglecting Higher Order Terms
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify the neglect of higher-order terms in alpha in the solution for the anharmonic oscillator.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms in the final expressions have consistent units.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when deriving the expressions for the solutions.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be careful not to omit any factors when substituting values into the equations.
